protocol.name: protocol
protocol.description: Messages, parameters and events common to every node and host.

messages.name: estop
messages.description: Stop everything now. Any node or host may send it; every node latches E-stop.

messages.name: estop_release
messages.description: Clear the E-stop latch, after operator action.

messages.name: sync
messages.description: Start of a control cycle. Nodes apply commands marked `apply: sync` on it.

messages.name: nmt
messages.description: Network management. The frame's dst picks the node (0 = all nodes).

messages.name: host_heartbeat
messages.description: Every host, all the time. Drives the leader election.

messages.name: lead_request
messages.description: The operator wants this host (node ID) to lead. Counter makes a repeat press new.

messages.name: heartbeat
messages.description: Every node. Lets hosts discover nodes, their type, health and firmware.

fields.name: schema_hash
fields.description: low 16 bits of the type's wire hash

messages.name: id_request
messages.description: A board with no ID asks for one, from src 255. Repeated with jitter until answered.

messages.name: id_assign
messages.description: The allocator's answer, sent to dst 255. The board checks the MAC and keeps the ID.

messages.name: service
messages.description: Request and response share one layout. Requests carry an op; the response repeats it with a status. src and dst in the ID say who asked and who answers.

messages.name: transfer
messages.description: ISO-TP frames for anything over 8 bytes (firmware images, logs). First byte of each transfer is a transfer_service.

messages.name: event
messages.description: Something happened on a node (or a host). Codes come from `events` below or the node type.

messages.name: debug_level
messages.description: Turn debugging on a node (dst) or all nodes up or down, optionally for a while.

messages.name: text
messages.description: Up to 7 characters of text for people (bench screen, serial console).

params.name: command_timeout_ms
params.description: Outputs stop if no command arrives for this long

params.name: leader_timeout_ms
params.description: Disarm if the leader's heartbeat stops for this long

params.name: debug_level
params.description: Current debug level (also set by the debug_level message)

params.name: led_mode
params.description: 0 off, 1 status, 2 activity, 3 owned by the application

params.name: event_rate_limit
params.description: Most events of one code a node sends per second

events.name: can_bus_off
events.cause: This node's transceiver, wiring or bitrate

events.name: can_rx_overflow
events.cause: CPU too busy or filters too wide

events.name: command_timeout
events.cause: Leader stopped, gateway crashed, or cable cut

events.name: leader_changed
events.description: New leader term seen; node disarmed

events.name: command_from_non_leader
events.description: Command from a host that doesn't lead (detail = sender)

events.name: watchdog_reset
events.description: Firmware hung and the watchdog reset it

events.name: crash
events.description: Firmware crashed (detail = low bits of PC)

events.name: params_corrupt
events.description: Saved parameters failed their check; defaults loaded

events.name: id_conflict
events.description: Another board answered with this node's ID

events.name: update_wrong_type
events.description: Image for another chip or node type refused

events.name: update_rollback
events.description: New image failed to confirm itself; old image restored

events.name: update_done
events.description: Running a new firmware image (detail = low bits of build)

events.name: schema_mismatch
events.description: Node's type hash differs from the host's schema

events.name: bad_frame
events.description: Known port with the wrong length or an invalid value (detail = port)

events.name: estop_local
events.description: This node's own E-stop input opened

events.name: message_rate_low
events.description: A stream arriving slower than its set rate

events.name: host_rx_overrun
events.description: The host's CAN controller dropped frames

events.name: bus_error_burst
events.description: Many bus error frames in a second (detail = type)

events.name: no_leader
events.description: Hosts are up but no leader is chosen

events.name: lead_changed
events.description: A host took the lead (detail = new leader)

events.name: node_id_assigned
events.description: A board got a node ID (detail = ID)

events.name: unknown_type
events.description: A node reports a type no schema file describes

types.name: esp32_bench
types.description: Bench test board reporting its own chip temperature, memory and CAN counters.

messages.name: status
messages.description: How the board itself is doing

fields.name: tx_frames
fields.description: low 16 bits of frames sent and acknowledged

actions.name: blink
actions.description: Blink the LED for this many seconds

types.name: motor_controller
types.description: Example two-channel velocity / duty motor controller.

messages.name: power
messages.description: Supply voltage and current

messages.name: setpoint
messages.description: What each channel should do

fields.name: target
fields.description: speed in velocity mode, or 0.01 % duty in duty mode

messages.name: feedback
messages.description: Measured speed and current per channel

params.name: kp_0
params.description: Velocity loop P gain per channel

params.name: kp_1
params.description: Velocity loop P gain per channel

params.name: ki_0
params.description: Velocity loop I gain per channel

params.name: ki_1
params.description: Velocity loop I gain per channel

params.name: kd_0
params.description: Velocity loop D gain per channel

params.name: kd_1
params.description: Velocity loop D gain per channel

actions.name: jog
actions.description: Spin channel 0 slowly for a second (bench test)

actions.name: autotune
actions.description: Tune the PID of channel N

events.name: driver_fault
events.description: The motor driver reported a fault

events.name: encoder_silent
events.description: Driving but no encoder counts (detail = channel)

types.name: analog_sensor
types.description: Example four-channel analog sensor board with two monitored supply rails.

messages.name: main_power
messages.description: Supply voltage and current

messages.name: aux_power
messages.description: Supply voltage and current

messages.name: readings
messages.description: Calibrated readings, one per channel

messages.name: raw
messages.description: Raw ADC counts

actions.name: tare
actions.description: Make channel N read 0 now (updates its offset)

events.name: sensor_missing
events.description: A channel reads open circuit (detail = channel)
